nom: Clinique All About Eyes Serum De-Puffing Eye Massage

avis.titre: Soothes puffy eyes in the morning
avis.texte: I tend to have puffy eyes in the morning, this does a great job of firming them up. I only use in the morning and use a separate eye cream at night for lines/wrinkles

avis.titre: Use every morning, reduces dark circles.
avis.texte: I love this stuff!!! Worth the price. I use it every morning. I also like to apply the All About Eyes cream beforehand for total de-puff of my eyes, especially for this tired mama on those early mornings.

avis.titre: I was Using it for AWHILE… doesn't work at all for me!!!
avis.texte: I was using this for quite awhile. Didn't work at all for me!!!
While it feels great going on, it doesn't seem to lighten my under eyes

avis.titre: No different than other products - doesn't really work
avis.texte: I don't really notice a difference when I use this. Not that moisturizing - doesn't help fine lines
Love this product I have been it for years. It is very refreshing for your eyes first thing in the morning
Not sure what type of magic is these but literaly in 2 minutes my under eyes looked amazing higly recomend

avis.titre: I would buy this product again and again.
avis.texte: I use it twice a day when I wake up in the morning and after I take my off my make up at night. Also, I stored in the refrigerator to get it even colder to reduce puffiness.

I bought this product months ago. I keep it because I figured out how it works for me. When i began using it, I didn't like it at all. It caused my eyes to water. My skin felt dry & tight, which caused additional irritation. I was planning on returning it but it fell to the bottom of my purse & I forgot about it for months. Current opinion: If I dont roll it too close to my waterline, and I only use it on the puffy part of my under eye skin, I have little to no irritation. Ill also only use it if I'm going to be in a photo or in the media. I dont use it daily, but when I use it, I can use it multiple times a day.
This Clinique eye serum has saved me. It's the only eye serum I can use under and above my very sensitive, allergy eyes. Thank you, Clinique!
For as much as this cost you think it would have some effect I don't see any difference at all I don't think it helps at all

avis.titre: A must have for my skincare collection!
avis.texte: I absolutely LOVE this product! It feels like a nice cold drink of water for my under eye area! It feels like it wakes up my tired eyes, and it hydrates effortlessly without leaving any stickiness or oiliness behind. I love that Clinique's products are formulated without scent, and never irritate my sensitive skin. I will mever be without this product. Also, it is priced super good considering it will last you well over 6 months, using it twice a day. A little definitely goes a lomg way.

avis.titre: I will continue to buy and buy and buy this product!!
avis.texte: This serum works magic on the puffiness under my eyes! I roll it on and fan my eyes to quickly dry the product. Just like that the puffiness is gone! I wear under my makeup and it works wonderful!
none of the liquid comes out on the roller when I try using it

avis.titre: I love it and now I'm going to buy some.
avis.texte: I got this product as a sample. I tried it and seconds later I could see the differnce.
I like how this glides under my eyes smoothly. It is very comfortable to use and does not leave any bad residue. My eyes feel more awake. Non-sticky.

My mom, who is 86 uses this every day. Sometimes twice a day for about the last 10 years and swears by it. She has no dark circles, no puffiness. No, nothing under her eyes. She kept telling me cause I have very puffy dark circle eyes to get it, I finally got it i've been using it two weeks like crazy and it has not helped not even a little bit still have puffy dark circles, I continue to use it, i'm gonna give it two more weeks and if it doesn't do anything, i'm returning it. I roll it on just like they said outer inner. Do it twice, tap it lightly in to smooth it into your skin. And then I use all my other products. It feels great, it's nice and cool, but it really does nothing for my eyes at all.
I will not purchase this item again. I have used it for over a week and have not seen any results.

I use this every morning after my skincare and before my caffeine hits, it helps to wake up my eyes and feels amazing! It's so soothing and refreshing around my eyes. I also use it after a good cry to help my puffy eyes bounce back. It doesn't say its anti wrinkle but it is the only eye product I use consistently and I have zero wrinkles around my eyes at 40. Ladies, buy this! You wont be sorry! I also have sensitive eyes and it never bothers them.
Don't really notice any difference, but the roller ball feels nice against my under eyes area. Guess you can't expect miracles at age 65. I could have gotten something similar for a lot less money.

Product is not the same and the quality of the actual roller device is badly made. Sharp where roller ball is in which scraped and even to get the product out you have to really squeeze the plastic. Test your tube mine might have been defective.
I love this product. The cool sweep feeling under my eyes makes me instantly awake and the product makes a visible difference within 15-30 minutes. I apply twice and then makeup overtop.
Huge waste of money. Feels nice going on but totally ineffective at depuffing my eyes.

I've been using this product for at least 3 years now. I can honestly say it does work for me. helps with the darkness and under eye wrinkles.. definitely. I'm buying again and again. I do sometimes put a caffeine based serum on top to depuff.
I use morning and night and don't live without. For a while there I got cheap and tried the Garnier one. It doesn't compare. It's better than coffee
I don't know what's finally working but I'm using this and my puffy eyes are much better. But I also cut out all the sine soooo… I was desperate
I love the application of this product. It has corrected my Puffy under eyes and discolored bags. This is always a morning necessity!

i have really bad under eye bags and my eyes swell horrendously every morning, my mom bought this for me as a christmas gift a year ago and it still has shown me little to no results. ive developed a rash over top one of my eyes from it too!!!! if you have sensitive skin, i would not recommend this. any time i put any cream on my eyes now the rash flares up and burns, definitely not what i was expecting from clinique 😭 its a nice cooling feel when you first put it on, but its not for me unfortunately :(

Not sure how well this actually works but I like it. The roller ball gives a cooling and gentle massage. The serum is lightweight and absorbs nicely. Works well with other products layered on top. I use this every morning on clean skin for a wake up.

I have used this product on and off, and I guess it has to be used religiously to see a noticeable improvement as I have yet to see one. The roller ball is refreshing and it does feel to absorb quickly into the skin without a residue feeling. I can only hope for the price that it will make a difference in what it's advertised for, but as of yet, nothing.
When my girlfriend got made up at Ulta, this product was recommended for her, and I couldn't wait to try it! Love this product so far. It's cool on my eyes, and I see puffiness seem to disappear!

avis.titre: Did absolutely nothing, would give 0 stars if possible
avis.texte: I was extremely disappointed with this product. It came highly recommend from a beauty expert in my local store, so I tried it out and wish I hadn't. I used it for a solid month before giving up on it.
Omg this product is wonderful. Thank you Ms v. Your the best. Yes I would tell a friend.

avis.titre: CLINIQUE All About Eyes Serum De-Puffing Eye Massage
avis.texte: I applied the product while it was cool to the touch under my eyes and it really works great.
I bought this hoping it would improve the .puffiness of my under eyes. I,'ve been using it for a week. How long does it take to see improvement?
Soothing and very cooling under the eyes! I have sensitive skin and had no issues with this product!
I like the way it feels and hope over time it will improve my puffy eyes

As I was asking info about a different brand, I was convinced that this is a better product. When I got home and tried to apply it, I realized that something is wrong. Basically no product gets applied unless pressed very hard in a delicate area. Bad
You don't feel any liquid come out of the tube?? Only the cool feel of the tip.
Absolutely amazing & actually depuffs & the cool roller ball feels amazing. No eye irritation whatsoever!

I haven't been using long enough to see results yet, but I'm mostly annoyed by trying to use it. The product doesn't seem to come out much when trying to use the rollerball tip. I can feel it just dragging instead of rolling & releasing the product. Not thrilled with it but started storing it upside down to try and help.
I have struggled to find an eye product that really does what it says it will do; help with puffiness. This product really achieved what I wanted.

This product feels great going on, and when you are not happy to be up in the morning, that is great. However, I am not sure it does anything else, I notice nothing after putting it on. I would not buy again.
I use this every day and love it. I think it helps with the under eye puffiness and circles under eye. Feels amazing going on.
I suffer with allergies and when I get up in the morning I roll this under my eyes and the cooling feels AMAZING and it truly relives the puffiness.

avis.titre: Love this product, I would buy it again
avis.texte: I would pay the price for this any day, it's worth it. Only been using it a few day & can already see a difference
But that's all it does. It does nothing for puffiness and seems to make my dark circles worse. Would not recommend
This feels really nice going on. Very cooling and light weight. As far as depuffing, I saw zero improvement. This was a waste of money.

been using g day and night and no change under eyes and lids still as puffy as b4 I purchased and that's been a few weeks now, being patient but left it at home whole traveling used drug store brand and poof puffy gone under eyes and that was for a lot less $$$. may need to return Always had faith in Clinic have used it for years off and on my skin gets used to its Ingredients very quickly so change out i guess that's why I had the cheap drug store stuff with a roller too.
Although this is advertised as allergy tested, when I used it, it caused a read rash under my eyes

After a horribly stressful 2 years, my eyes showed it. Dark circles, puffy yet sunken somehow, wrinkles and lines and crows feet… they were a mess. I had almost given up hope, then the Ulta girl suggested I try this. OMG, this has saved my poor late 40s eyes! I use it morning and night, and if I'm not wearing makeup I'll use it a couple of times throughout the day, too. I slather it on pretty generously, let it soak in for a minute or two, and then gently tap in the remaining/ blend it outward. I did a side by side of my eyes just before buying this vs. after just 1 week of daily use and the difference is insane! I'm not normally a fan of Clinique products, but this will be a permanent resident of my arsenal!!
I have been applying this every morning for 25+ years. It works like a charm and lasts "forever!"

I like the application of this product. It gently rolls on and feels cool to the skin. It really does reduce the morning puffiness and alleviates a lot the the bags under my eyes. I would recommend this product.
Morning on a clean face and nighttime after makeup is removed.

avis.titre: This stuff is amazing for puffiness!!
avis.texte: I've tried every product under the sun for under eye bags & this stuff is the first product to actually work!

i use it after i wake up or if you have cried and it helps reduce puffy eyes, now if you have genetic puffiness it won't help bc that's how your skin always is, but if it's from waking up or crying it will help with that puffiness
I use this twice a day and love it. Would definitely buy again

I have puffiness underneath my eyes due to genetics & life with a newborn so I was hopeful this product would reduce my tired puffy eyes but I saw no difference, even applied several times. I didn't expect miracles but thought it might of helped somewhat so I will be returning.

*Please read* I have been using this same product since I was 15 years now i am 27. I love this product because it really remove my eye bags and and dark color under my eyelid. I only put this product in when my eyes look tired.I dont think this will be a good product for dark spots/ aging spot. For aging spot and wrinkles I will recommend Age IQ Neora it's pricey. my mom (age48) uses this product took her 3 months to see results.
I do like the roller but I have seen no difference in my eyes after using it. not worth the price.

I don't feel this depuffs at all. And I feel dry after using it, not like my eyes are moisturized. I also feel like my eyes looks older (I'm 33 and don't have much aging yet), accentuating the fine lines I have and making the dark circles look darker. I'll finish the roller because I paid for it, but will not be purchasing again. The roller feels cold when applying, which does few nice.

avis.titre: All About Nothing-Doesn't Help Dark Circles
avis.texte: I use Clinique's All About Eyes Serum De-Puffing Eye Massage twice a day, under my makeup. I purchased it in the store from a sales associate specifically so have something to put ON my dark circles since they were accentuated on zoom calls. He instead recommended I buy this product. I told him that I had unsuccessfully tried other de-puffing products, but he said this would take care of my problem. It did not. This product is not made for people with chronic thin skin under their eyes like me.

avis.titre: All About Nothing-Doesn't Help Dark Circles
avis.texte: I use Clinique's All About Eyes Serum De-Puffing Eye Massage twice a day, under my makeup. I purchased it in the store from a sales associate specifically so have something to put ON my dark circles since they were accentuated on zoom calls. He instead recommended I buy this product. I told him that I had unsuccessfully tried other de-puffing products, but he said this would take care of my problem. It did not. This product is not made for people with chronic thin skin under their eyes like me.

avis.titre: Feels good but doesn't do much:/
avis.texte: The roller is always cold and feels amazing on the eyes, but the serum dries weirdly and doesn't de-puff very well. I don't really notice a difference after using it.

I was directed away from the undereye patches by an employee whom then hooked me up with this product , which was twice the price. She said shd had heard good reviews from customers. When I saw the rollorball I could just feel it gently smoothing under my eyes. I was amazed after one use. The rollor ball is so cooling and just glides with no pulling at my 56 year old under eyes! It is pricey but I use my points and this is worth it!
As I stated above, product glides on easily with no tugging around the eye area.
I keep this in my fridge. This glides on very gently around the eye, feels really good and hydrating. The name could not be more relevant-"Eye Massage".
honestly, wouldn't buy again, it is nothing to write home about.

avis.titre: Caused my eyes to swell shut
avis.texte: I bought this because my eyes have been puffy in the morning. First application was comical really as it did the opposite of what it was supposed to do. As soon as I swiped it over my eyelids they started puffing up and almost swelled shut. Had to take Benadryl to counteract it.

I have under eye bags/puffiness. This was HiGhLY recommended by a store employee. So far, it's done nothing. There's no change in the appearance of my under eye area. Yes, it does fee cool when you apply but that's it. Pretty bummed. Oh well, my search continues!

avis.titre: I have used this product for YEARS!!
avis.texte: I roll this all around my eyes; lids, undereye, etc. It feels great and it really works to reduce puffiness and add a glow to the eye area. For optimal use, keep in the refrigerator!

avis.titre: Beyond happy to have found this product!!
avis.texte: Absolutely the best, hands down. I used to use Benefit Puff-Off and was devastated when it was ddiscontinued.This product not only replaces it, but works even better.
I really enjoyed this product! the roller is very cooling it feels so nice on my eye!

avis.titre: I'm not such about this product
avis.texte: I use this product both mornings and night and so far I haven't seen much of a difference. I have seen my eyes get slightly brighter and not as tired but not much else. Haven't decided if I'll buy again

I have some of the worst under eye circles I've ever seen. They look like I've been sucker punched days ago and they're healing, as someone pointed out to me. They cover under my eyes and swirl around both sides to the top of my eyelids and up. Tbh it could be eye make up, if it weren't a tanner/redder/purpler-er color. I drink water, exercise, eat healthy, sleep well, meditate, all the thing. I've tried cheap products, moderately priced products, and science project products (looking at you coconut oil), to no avail. I've been using this serum day and night for about a week now and my eyelids are less pronounced, less dark. That is progress folks! So it's a 5 star for me because it actually changed something that literally nothing else has. Hopefully with prolonged use, I can look at the mirror and not marvel at my lack of fighting skills.
I LOVE this product. It is so moisturizing and I love applying it. I would buy over and over again. 10/10 from the past years I've been using.
One of the skincare products I can't live without. I few rolls under each eye every morning brightens under eye circles and reduces puffiness.

I have been using this product for 2 weeks so far. I took a before picture and then another one after 2 weeks and I'm not seeing any difference to the puffiness under my eyes. I will continue to use for another 2 weeks and see if there is any progress.
This is soothing and works immediately.. results are not permanent but easy to reapply small amount if needed..
I do see some results using this. It absorbs well for a creme.. does make eyes water if it gets into them while applying makeup.. prefer to use at night for that reason.
Have used twice a day for two weeks, no change in puffiness or dark circles.
I have been using this product for well over a year hoping that i would see a difference, nothing, i see no difference at all. Save your money.

When I asked an Ulta rep what the best thing was for bags under the eyes she immediately went to this product and said she has been using it for years. I tested this under my eyes and after less than 10 minutes saw a difference in the mirror. Can't wait to see what regular use does.
Sales lady said this line was new for aging, lol! Literally did nothing, do not buy!

After I wash my face in the morning, apply moisturizer then apply a very thin layer this product then a thing layer of All about eyes. I have a ton of allergies so under my eyes are very puffy in the morning. Within 15 mins no more puffy eyes.

Clinique is my go to brand for all my skincare needs. This year has be a crazy one with switching careers and getting married so I have been feeling (and looking!) exhausted. I was hoping this would help relieve some of the baggy ness I was noticing under my eyes but I have not seen any results.

I was hopeful about using this product with all the great reviews. However, after using the product religiously for almost a month I'm Wondering if the people with results bought something else! This stuff hasn't improved a thing to my under eye bags. Not one improvement. Don't waste your money because it's expensive and doesn't work.

avis.titre: I would not buy this product again
avis.texte: I purchased it for puffiness under my eyes it has not worked for me on day 5 still not seeing results

I use this in the am because I wake up with super puffy eyes and it feels so good and cool! Throughout the day my eyes eventually de-puff but I'm not sure if it's from drinking water or using this. When I use it before bed I still wake up with super puffy eyes, which is why I'm giving it 4 stars.
I love this stuff, it definitely takes care of puffy eye bags! It would be PERFECT if it also brightened.

avis.titre: Feels really good , but slow results
avis.texte: Feels really good (cooling) when applied. Slight tightening of the skin around area used, but definitely used cheaper products that had stronger, immediate skin tightening effects (ie. Burts Bee). Used for a week, eye bags seem to be less, but the dark circles look the same. Again, there are definitely products out there cheaper that had stronger effects, quicker. I chose to try this because of its easy ball application and brand name.
This is a great product I continue to buy again and again. The roller ball is so cooling and the serum consistently reduces my eye bags. Amazing
